prompts.assassin: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed production character reference sheet for Threadbound, a 2.5D feudal Japanese fishing village fantasy. Input reference image is the earlier approved Indoor Wall Hunters sheet: preserve the lean athletic EAVE RUNNER A silhouette, indigo hood, short cloth tails, wrapped legs, simple bracers and short single-edged blade. New requirement: the enemy is a deliberately WOVEN guardian aligned with the Hermit's Balance faction, NOT a human ninja wearing fabric. Exposed forearms, fingers, ankles and neck are layered dark flax/indigo twisted cord bundles, with conspicuous tied joints, parallel taut fibers and a few gaps revealing a hollow woven core. Absolutely no human skin, realistic eyes or hair. Face is a small aged ivory ceramic mask with two dark narrow eye slits, restrained pale blue inner light, simple blue stitched crack repair. Indigo hood and cropped overlapping cloth panels, short waist tails no longer than a forearm, weathered reed/bronze bracer strips and tabi-like woven feet. Strong painted textile texture and believable garment folds, large restrained forms, dark charcoal/indigo with ivory mask and muted flax knots; tiny cyan accents, no neon body. Visible paired-loop binding knot on chest and forehead is the proposed shared faction motif. Simple short iron slashing blade and one small throwing needle. On a clean warm grey concept-sheet background show a large full-body front three-quarter view in relaxed ready stance, smaller back and side views, close-up of exposed cord wrist/knee and ceramic mask, plus 3 small silhouette-readable pose studies: braced against a wood wall with planted hand/feet, committed diagonal jump slash, low landing recovery. High-end hand-painted game character concept, coherent modelable anatomy, equal proportions across views, practical details, not a photoreal human, no giant cape or long loose ribbons. Text limited to EAVE RUNNER / WOVEN GUARDIAN and small view labels.
prompts.flying: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: two-option flying enemy concept board for Threadbound's Blue biome, ancient feudal Japanese lakeside fishing village. Input image is reference for painterly game rendering, aged ivory ceramic, dark indigo fabric and rope; do not copy human bodies. The enemies are visibly woven guardians serving the Hermit's preservation of Balance, with their exact maker left unexplained. Distinct from ordinary humans, generic bats and glowing water-bulb traversal flowers. Large header BLUE BIOME / WOVEN FLYERS. Left option A LOOM HERON: angular heron-like bird made from reed/walnut spars, layered dark indigo woven wing panels like suspended loom cloth, small aged ivory pointed ceramic face/beak, short knotted cord feet, visible tension cords and a paired-loop binding knot. Broad readable V silhouette, wings have segmented fabric feather-like panels and stitching, NOT realistic feathered bird and not a paper origami toy. Show main full-body three-quarter flight view, compact folded-wing perch, and small dive/brake pose pair. Its attack role is a single committed diagonal diving strike and a reachable recovery. Right option B BOBBIN MOTH: compact nonhumanoid spindle/bobbin body of wound charcoal thread, tiny ivory face plate, four broad kite-shaped dark-indigo fabric wings held by thin reed struts with tension strings and stitched edging, symmetrical paired-loop binding motif, no glowing orb abdomen and no luminous flower silhouette. Show main three-quarter hover view, side silhouette showing tiny bobbin body, and small windup/release studies for one thrown straight thread needle. Both are roughly player-body to two player-width scale; large simple silhouette and exquisite worn textile/ceramic detail, restrained desaturated teal and pale cyan attack accents, warm flax knots, grounded in fishing nets and village materials. Clean warm-grey museum-style concept sheet, rich hand-painted game concept art, consistent construction across all views, no extra designs, no humans or full environment, no lore paragraphs.
prompts.weave: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating PBR diffuse albedo material tile for the body of a woven fantasy guardian. Entire image is flat edge-to-edge textile material, not a person, outfit, prop, character sheet, perspective or scene. Dense visibly intertwined thin twisted flax cord bundles in deep charcoal and faded midnight indigo, alternating narrow vertical warp threads and horizontal tied bindings, small occasional worn flax highlights and subtle desaturated slate blue fibers. The texture must show round twisted cord fibers and tightly interlaced strands rather than ordinary flat denim. Fine tactile detail, moderate natural color variation, broad overall dark value, crisp but not harsh, hand-painted AAA stylized game surface. Neutral even illumination, no baked cast shadows or volumetric drapery, no cyan glow, no text or symbols or border. Square seamless tile, high texture detail.
prompts.ceramic: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless square PBR diffuse albedo ceramic material for a hand-painted game guardian mask. Fill the entire image edge-to-edge with warm aged ivory porcelain, faint slate-grey patina, subtle fine crazing, tiny dark pinpricks and restrained small worn chips. Very gentle color variation. Do not depict a mask, face, object, tile grid or clothing. No eyes, lettering, symbols or blue motif. Neutral even illumination, no cast shadow or specular highlight. Fine realistic surface detail under a restrained painterly game finish. Seamless flat material tile.
